patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Gorgias and Zendesk Suite share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Gorgias and Zendesk Suite share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Gorgias only if your buying job matches “Ecommerce helpdesk with ticket-based pricing — Starter $40/mo (50 tickets); Basic $77/mo a” rather than Zendesk Suite's shape. Choose Zendesk Suite only if your buying job matches “Enterprise helpdesk and Suite omnichannel — Support Team from $19/agent/mo annual; Suite T” rather than Gorgias's shape. Workflow advantage: Gorgias leans ecommerce-support; Zendesk Suite leans omnichannel-support, ai-customer-service. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Gorgias and Zendesk Suite share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Gorgias is Ecommerce helpdesk with ticket-based pricing — Starter $40/mo (50 tickets); Basic $77/mo annual ($90 monthly).; Zendesk Suite is Enterprise helpdesk and Suite omnichannel — Support Team from $19/agent/mo annual; Suite Team $55, Suite Pro $115..
- Company-size focus: Gorgias (small-business, mid-market) vs Zendesk Suite (mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Gorgias-leaning ecommerce-support vs Zendesk Suite-leaning omnichannel-support, ai-customer-service.
- Researched limits: Gorgias — Ticket caps on Starter/Basic — overages raise TCO quickly; Zendesk Suite — Suite Pro at $115/agent/mo annual is expensive for SMB teams.

Limitations — Gorgias: Ticket caps on Starter/Basic — overages raise TCO quickly; Not per-agent pricing — high-volume teams need careful tier math; Zendesk Suite: Suite Pro at $115/agent/mo annual is expensive for SMB teams; Zendesk Sell (CRM) is a separate product — do not conflate slugs.

Poor-fit cases: Gorgias is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Ticket caps on Starter/Basic — overages raise TCO quickly · Zendesk Suite is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Suite Pro at $115/agent/mo annual is expensive for SMB teams · Avoid Gorgias if you actually need Zendesk Suite's motion (Enterprise helpdesk and Suite omnichannel — Support Team from $19/agent/mo annua)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
